_comment: GOL-108 never-as-text baseline. Each entry is an EXISTING color/fill use of a light-on-light brand token. Adding a NEW entry means you are putting gold/tan text on a surface — it MUST be a dark surface, and you must re-run --update to record it. See BRAND-A11Y.md. Existing entries are audited at render time under GOL-106.
allow: app/globals.css :: /* Kicker line (replaces the old "№ 01" generic numbering with a typographic mono+rule treatment that reads as an almanac heading rather than a list index). */ .grows-card__kicker :: color: var(--harvest-gold)

app/globals.css :: /* Leaf glyph replaces the "Pillar 01 / Pillar 02" mono numbering. The numbering felt like a SaaS landing template; a serif italic flourish with a small botanical mark reads as almanac chapter-heading. */ .about-vision-pillar__glyph :: color: var(--harvest-gold)

app/globals.css :: /* Prose anchor — italic harvest-gold display emphasis used inside body prose (e.g. "Chestnuts. The main event."). Distinct from the mono row labels so the eye reads it as part of the sentence, not a tag. */ .prose-anchor :: color: var(--harvest-gold)
